name: wxlike-ui
description: wxlike desktop frontend (WP-11): TypeScript + jotai, bundled by esbuild into dist/ for Tauri

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/app.js --minify && node scripts/copy-dist-assets.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:wire && npm run check:msgindex
